why_added: The October 10 post-result sensitivity showed both positive null-relative NN slopes lose positive 95% site-cluster lower bounds after adjusting repeat-supported cohort size m. Raw NN2 MNKA slope changes from -12.929 to +3.362 when m is controlled. m is positively associated with MNKA and its conditioning is not a causal mediation model.

prospective_boundary.added_required_report: When new RELEASE-2026-excluded response becomes estimable, also estimate MNKA slopes for the same two NN excess metrics after controlling m and show separate m+B sensitivity, preserving the original fixed effects and null definitions.
prospective_boundary.ecological_claim_guard: If unadjusted future gates pass but either m-adjusted slope has site-cluster interval including zero or negative point slope, classify as sampling-sensitive spatial pattern, not a robust density-specific local-spacing finding.
prospective_boundary.no_rescue: This added diagnostic cannot rescue a failed original prospective gate, and cannot be declared original prespecification.
prospective_boundary.causal_warning: m may represent detection intensity, organism availability, and real abundance simultaneously; conditioning does not prove or refute competition, territoriality, or habitat avoidance.

next_independent_evidence: Independent tag-specific detection model or external behavioral tracking with co-location/spacing measurement; no additional same-RELEASE subgroup selection.
